$comment: Where you stand — the obligations register. Authored data, never generated (CLAUDE.md §8). Every row carries source, sourceUrl and verifiedOn. A row older than reviewCadenceDays shows 'verification due'. A jurisdiction or activity not in this file shows 'not covered yet' — never a guess. Every row stays draft:true until the licensed tax consultancy has reviewed it; the page says so in the voice until then. Empty at milestone 1; filled at milestone 2; reviewed at milestone 3.

schema.title: the obligation as the visitor would name it
schema.appliesWhen: an object of intake answer ids to the values that match
schema.nextDate: absolute where derivable, otherwise relative — 'within 3 months of licence issue'
schema.penaltyAed: the number, or a range as [low, high]
schema.penaltyNote: how the penalty grows with delay, where it does
schema.sourceUrl: the page the figure was read from
schema.verifiedOn: YYYY-MM-DD, the day a person last checked the source
schema.draft: true until the tax review signs the row off
